_comment_1: Copy to config.json next to ClaudeUsageCollector.exe (the installer does this for you) and fill in server_url + ingest_token.
_comment_2: upload_content controls how much data the collector sends. true = full conversation text (lets the dashboard show what was discussed). false = metadata only (token counts, models, project names, timestamps -- no prompt or response text leaves this machine). Default is true. Edit and the next scheduled run picks the new value up.
_comment_3: projects_dirs overrides where to look for Claude Code JSONL files. null = defaults (~/.claude/projects and the Xcode coding-assistant dir).
_comment_4: analytics_orgs powers the dashboard's Team Activity tab. The `team-activity` command runs DAILY on THIS machine (where a valid claude.ai Cookie lives), fetches claude.ai's per-user admin analytics for each org below, and pushes it to the dashboard DB. Add one entry per organization you admin. `org` is the organization UUID (from the /organizations/<UUID>/... URL). `cookie` is the FULL Cookie header copied from a logged-in claude.ai request (DevTools -> Network -> any request -> Request Headers -> Cookie). It must contain sessionKey=... ; including cf_clearance/__cf_bm helps clear Cloudflare. `org_name` is just a label for the dashboard dropdown. When a cookie expires the dashboard flags that org. Leave the array empty to disable Team Activity collection.
_comment_5: analytics_days_back = which single day the daily Team Activity run collects, as days back from today. 1 = yesterday. Each run stores ONE day of per-user activity (window [day, day+1)) under that day's date. Must be >= 1: claude.ai rejects a same-day/future date with HTTP 400 and only a completed day has settled data. To load history run `ClaudeUsageCollector.exe team-activity --backfill 30` (last 30 days, one by one); add --reset to wipe first.
